title: 统计区间中的整数数目
summary: 设计结构支持添加闭区间，并查询所有已添加区间并集包含的不同整数数量。
insight: 用 TreeMap 保存互不重叠且不相邻的合并区间与总覆盖数。添加时找到可能与新区间相交的前驱，并不断合并所有起点不大于 right+1 的区间，先扣旧长度再加新长度。

solutions.title: 有序不交区间并集
solutions.idea: 每次只访问并删除与新区间相交或相邻的现有区间。
steps: 定位 floorEntry(left)，若其 end+1>=left 则从它开始，否则 ceilingEntry(left)
while entry.start<=right+1：扩展左右边界、covered 扣旧区间长度并删除
插入合并区间，covered 加新长度；count 返回 covered

code.java: class CountIntervals { TreeMap<Integer,Integer> intervals=new TreeMap<>();long covered;public CountIntervals(){}public void add(int left,int right){Map.Entry<Integer,Integer> entry=intervals.floorEntry(left);if(entry==null||entry.getValue()+1<left)entry=intervals.ceilingEntry(left);while(entry!=null&&entry.getKey()<=right+1){left=Math.min(left,entry.getKey());right=Math.max(right,entry.getValue());covered-=entry.getValue()-entry.getKey()+1L;intervals.remove(entry.getKey());entry=intervals.ceilingEntry(left);}intervals.put(left,right);covered+=right-left+1L;}public int count(){return (int)covered;} }
code.kotlin: class CountIntervals { private val intervals=java.util.TreeMap<Int,Int>();private var covered=0L;fun add(leftValue:Int,rightValue:Int){var left=leftValue;var right=rightValue;var entry=intervals.floorEntry(left);if(entry==null||entry.value+1<left)entry=intervals.ceilingEntry(left);while(entry!=null&&entry.key<=right+1){left=minOf(left,entry.key);right=maxOf(right,entry.value);covered-=entry.value-entry.key+1L;intervals.remove(entry.key);entry=intervals.ceilingEntry(left)};intervals[left]=right;covered+=right-left+1L}fun count()=covered.toInt()}
code.cpp: class CountIntervals { map<int,int> intervals;long long covered=0;public:CountIntervals(){}void add(int left,int right){auto iterator=intervals.upper_bound(left);if(iterator!=intervals.begin()){auto previous=prev(iterator);if(previous->second+1>=left)iterator=previous;}while(iterator!=intervals.end()&&iterator->first<=right+1){left=min(left,iterator->first);right=max(right,iterator->second);covered-=iterator->second-iterator->first+1LL;iterator=intervals.erase(iterator);}intervals[left]=right;covered+=right-left+1LL;}int count(){return covered;} };
